contamination_summary: src/astrarun/tools/projects.py had a hardcoded test command fallback running 'pytest tests/test_milestone5_resident_app.py -k test_user_sid_extraction' when a project had no defined 'test' command.
root_cause: Historical milestone test scaffolding left in production capability code.

remediation.action: Removed hardcoded milestone5 pytest fallback. When a project has no configured command, run_project_command returns an honest failure CapabilityResult with error_code=NOT_FOUND, reason_code='PROJECT_COMMAND_UNRESOLVED', and message explaining that the command is not defined.
